test(export): grid spec checks both edges on a long run; goldens pin combined attributes and a decomposed mark (rich-export-9a1.5)

The e2e spec read only each grapheme's left edge, which for a wide glyph is
the x attribute read back, and a lost textLength failed it by 0.14px. It now
checks the right edge too and adds a 30-cell ASCII chunk; both mutations fail
by ~4px.

The golden fixture's e-with-two-marks was a precomposed é plus one mark; it is
now e + U+0301 + U+0302. A row pins reverse+dim, reverse+conceal and
underline2+strike, the pairs resolved together.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(export): golden HTML and SVG exports under two themes, and SVG glyphs on the cell grid in Chromium (rich-export-9a1.5)

The fixture's attribute rows come from ATTRIBUTE_NAMES, so an attribute
added to Style changes the goldens instead of being skipped. Deleting the
handling of any ExportLook field in either exporter fails a golden; the
Playwright spec fails when textLength is dropped.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(export): saveSvg writes Console.exportSvg to a file (rich-export-9a1.4) (#243)

* feat(export): saveSvg writes Console.exportSvg to a file (rich-export-9a1.4)

saveSvg joins saveText and saveHtml in src/node/save.ts, its options typed
from Console.exportSvg. The themes demo gains EXPORT_SVG, which is what
demonstrates the new export to the coverage gate.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(demo): export rows carry their options as data (rich-export-9a1.4)

The SVG row wrapped saveSvg in a lambda with a hand-typed options shape;
each row now carries options and the loop adds clear: false. app.ts's
header points at index.ts instead of restating one of its env vars.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
